text:
maria: Drafted a regional fallthrough protocol and benchmark plan — goal: measure end-to-end latency/99s during region drain with varying KV hit rates and kernel-selection heuristics. PTAL :eyes:

alex: Nice. Do you have a concrete set of traffic mixes? synthetic vs replay? we need at least two QPS shapes: sustained + short spike.

maria: Yep. Proposal:
- Synthetic: 60/30/10 split short/medium/long seqs, steady 1k qps with 3x 10s spikes.
- Replay: 3 representative customer traces (chatty, assistant, embeddings-seq) with original timing.
- Control knobs: target_batch_size, kv_priming_ratio, kernel_policy (fast-path vs quantized-fallback)

jasper: Important to keep KV priming deterministic across runs. Suggest adding a pre-warm step:
```
# pre-warm KV cache to X% hit-rate
./replay_harness --trace traceA --prime 0.6 --duration 60
```
Also log per-request kv_hit boolean.

li: For apples-to-apples (we should avoid that phrase but you know), we need to align batching windows and max_tokens. I recommend fixing `batch_window_ms=5` and `max_batch_tokens=8192` for baselines.

maria: Agreed. Also we should pin model version and quantization config to avoid hidden drift. I'll add a config blob to the run metadata.

ops-bot: deploy requested: region-fallthrough-v2 to staging-cluster (id: stg-7). CI run queued: https://ci.internal/runs/7421

alex: One regression we saw in earlier smoke: when kernel_policy=auto the quantized kernel picks for short sequences increase tail latency. We should measure kernel-switch counts per minute.

jasper: Add this metric:
```
runtime.kernel_switches_total{region="us-east-1"}
```
and sample stacks on 95+ tail events.

maria: Plan for acceptance: 3 golden runs (same seed) for each combination: {fast-path, quantized-fallback} x {gp-sim, replay-traceA, traceB}. Compare median, p95, p99, and cost-per-token.

li: For multi-region failover, include a synthetic 'blackhole' at t=120s to simulate region drain; ensure fallback model mapping uses fallthrough policy (prefer warm compatible model) vs immediate remote-hot fallback.

alex: We should capture end-to-end RTT including routing overhead. Add client-side timing in harness and server-side trace id propagation.

maria: I'll run an initial sweep tonight and post logs. If anyone wants ownership for correlation (kv hit -> kernel picks -> tail), volunteer?

jasper: I can take kernel-to-kv correlation plots. Will sketch dashboards for runtime.kernel_switches_total vs kv_hit_ratio.

maria: Thanks. Quick note: keep threads short in the run logs. If we hit a perf regression, create a followup thread with the failing run id and minimal repro.

loadbot: loadtest started: run=7421, group=regional-fallthrough, expected-duration=45m

maria: Great — will post updates in this thread as runs finish. :rocket:
